policy.selection: Seventeen remaining bus routes with at most eight unmatched directed pairs on Friday, excluding the already reviewed Thun 2 coordinate conflict. policy.roadRule: Only missing directed pairs with an existing official operator/mode/line crosswalk. All full-pattern contexts must provide a valid identical path under 80 m snap and max(1200 m, 4.5 times direct distance). No stop relocation, clipped calls, arbitrary gap bridge, or assertion of observed or operator-certified physical direction.

matte.finding: Operator specifies a vertical passenger lift with 29.90 m rise and two opposite entrances. The roughly 4 m horizontal separation of GTFS stop coordinates does not establish a transport axis. No horizontal line is invented.

source.interpretation: Complete national FOT cableway installation, station and axis census retained; Bern applies only separately reviewed installation bindings. No altitude, sag or observed motion.

roadSource.description: Geofabrik Switzerland 2026-09-02 plus OSM border extract retrieved 2026-09-08

policy.roadRule: Only missing directed pairs on these existing operator/line crosswalks; all full-pattern contexts on both dates must agree on the identical valid path. 80 m snap, 4.5 detour ratio / 1200 m floor. Failed and context-dependent paths remain excluded. No road direction or temporary-diversion certification.
policy.tramRule: Only the two Bahnhof J / Hirschengraben directed platform pairs. Cantonal tram line 30_003 supplies the station loop shown in the dated BERNMOBIL diversion plan; retain every previously matched line 6 segment. Other line 6 depot/Guisanplatz gaps remain excluded.

exclusions.finding: Both temporary Luisenstrasse records share a coordinate on the closed lower Thunstrasse. Operator specifies inbound Marienstrasse 23 and outbound Kirchenfeldstrasse at Mottastrasse. The inferred paths follow the closed corridor. No stop relocation or increased tolerance is authorized by the source model; both routes remain excluded.

urbanSupplement.model: Missing-pair supplements only. OSM paths are inferred, not operator-certified; tram station approaches use separately identified cantonal line 30_003.

census.boundaryRule: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Bern canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Bern. No operator whitelist.
census.allYearMeaning: All trip records in the pinned annual archive, including records inactive on both validation dates; not a claim of operating every day.

scopeLimits: GTFS fixed-stop archive and all OEVTP line records inventoried; services absent from both sources and GTFS-Flex service areas are not a verified census of every real-world service.
Two September civil days do not establish holiday, winter or year-round pattern coverage.
Cross-boundary journeys keep all calls. Entire patterns failing any segment are excluded, including source extents shorter than their timetable journeys.

Geometry uses official-line centrelines plus identified OSM road and FOT rail/cableway supplements; not observed movement, legal one-way validation or running-track selection. Dated diversion evidence is limited to the reviewed tram 6 station approach.
